senses.gloss: m. (paganus) villager, commoner, civilian. Y’lamd. to Lev. V, 21, quot. in Ar. פולח פ׳ וכ׳ a soldier and a civilian who provoked the king to anger (Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Leviticus 6">Vayikra 6</cite> <he>קרתני ובן פלטרין</he>). Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Vayera 21; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50">Gen. R. s. 50</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="O00116"><he>סָגוּם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15">Num. R. s. 15</cite>; Tanḥ. Bhaʿăl. 11; ed. Bub. 20 <he>היום איפרכוס למחר פ׳ למחר קומוס למחר סרדיוט</he> (not <he>סגן</he>) (under the Roman government) one is to-day a consul, to-morrow a civilian &c., v. <cite ref="O01540"><he>סְרַדְיוֹט</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="Q00039"><he>פָּגָאנִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00039"><he>פָּגָנִים</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> (Matt. K. <cite ref="Q00039"><he>פָּגָאנִין</he></cite>).
